title: Differential drive kinematics and calibration
keywords: kinematics wheel radius separation calibration multiplier drift curve curving odometry wrong distance rotation smear
text: For a differential drive, v = r (wR + wL) / 2 and w = r (wR - wL) / b, with wheel radius r, wheel separation b and wheel speeds wL and wR in rad/s. A wrong wheel_radius scales distances (the robot drives 1.1 m when told 1 m), a wrong wheel_separation scales rotation (the map smears while the robot turns), and unequal left and right radii make it curve when it should drive straight. Calibrate by driving a measured straight line and turning a known number of times, then correct left_wheel_radius_multiplier, right_wheel_radius_multiplier and wheel_separation_multiplier.
